name: clearance
description: Machine-wide resource clearance for Claude Code sessions and subagents: see the headroom, and get cleared, held or diverted before launching more.

minFreeGB.title: Available memory floor (GB)
minFreeGB.description: Available RAM (free plus standby) that must remain after admitting a session or subagent. 0 means learned: where this machine was seen to start paging hard, and 5% of RAM until it has been. A positive value fixes it.

maxCommitPct.title: Commit ceiling (%)
maxCommitPct.description: Committed memory as a share of the commit limit, after admitting.

maxSessions.title: Session ceiling
maxSessions.description: Most local Claude sessions at once.

maxAgents.title: Subagent ceiling
maxAgents.description: Most subagents in flight across the machine.

sessionBaselineGB.title: New session cost (GB)
sessionBaselineGB.description: 0 means learned: an upper bound on what this machine's sessions were seen to grow to. A positive value fixes it.
